outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo, not a plot of averaged data.
The scatter/mean plot in panel B shows individual gray dots for each biological replicate overlaid on the mean ± SEM bars, as stated in the caption.
Panel C consists of micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows individual yellow dots for each cell overlaid on the mean ± SEM.
Panel E shows individual blue dots for each cell overlaid on the mean ± SEM.
Panel F consists of super-resolution PALM microscopy images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows individual gray dots for each cell overlaid on the mean ± SEM.
Panel H shows individual gray dots for each cluster overlaid on the mean ± SEM.
Panel I shows individual gray dots for each cell overlaid on the mean ± SEM.
